description:
700C Road bike with 14 speed shifting system and alloy dual disc brake. Wheel width/diameter: 1.2 inch /25.2''. Recommended for rider's height 5'3 inch -6'0 inch . Max weight up to 330lbs.

Strong aluminum frame is up to the terrible road situations and the purpose for stable-riding can be fulfilled. It also provides comfortable and adjustable handle bar and seat post for you.

Allow you to switch through the gears very quickly with your finger tips, so you can quickly select a gear for every terrain. High-performance 700C tires can solve multiple challenges and problems of rigorous street racing.

Bike's frame geometry offers a more relaxed position for all riding styles, with a shallow handlebar drop so that you can still be comfortable when riding in the lower handlebar position.

Easy to assemble, includes all the tools you need for building and maintaining it. Enjoy different speed cycling experience, like a wind chaser!
